title: Blue Book heads grow increasingly anti-UFO, 1952-1969

tellings.quote: every single head of blue book from that point forward from 52 to 69 when it ended uh became progressively more kind of anti-ufo
We know the Air Force tried to marginalize UFOs with Blue Book,
tellings.difference: This telling blames the Air Force for deliberately using Blue Book to marginalize UFOs, rather than describing successive Blue Book heads becoming more anti-UFO over time.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Jesse Michels saying that the Air Force's Project Blue Book turned against UFOs from 1952 to 1969, when it ended. The telling puts this as the Air Force using Blue Book to marginalize the subject, and the story puts it as each Blue Book head becoming more anti-UFO.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that every head of Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, became more and more against UFOs from 1952 until the project ended in 1969. In another episode he tells it a bit differently, saying the Air Force used Blue Book on purpose to sideline the UFO question. If true, it would mean the official study was steered away from taking the subject seriously.
